lines.text: The disciples rebuked people bringing babies to Jesus, but Jesus called the children to Him.
Jesus said anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.
A ruler said he had kept the commandments from his youth, and Jesus told him to sell everything and have treasure in Egypt.
Jesus said it is easier for a sheep to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter God's kingdom.
Jesus said what is impossible with man is possible with God, and promised those who leave everything eternal life in the age to come.
